---
name: Question
about: Ask a question about usage, methodology, or results
title: "[Question] "
labels: question
assignees: []
---

**Question**
Ask your question clearly.

**Context**
What are you trying to do? Which part of the project (SDK, CLI, evidence
bundles, statistics, protocol) is involved?

**What you've already tried**
What documentation or code you've already checked, so we don't repeat it.

**Note on scientific claims**
If your question is about the experimental results, please note that
DriveEvidenceLab distinguishes three conclusion layers (internal consistency /
methodological validity / external reproduction). Questions about results are
welcome, but please cite the protocol version and evidence artifact you are
referring to.
